Classic Butter Icing
By: Maria Boyer
Published: Sunday, April 11, 2010 - 7:29pm

Ingredients




 cup butter, softened
3 cups powdered sugar
1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
2 tablespoons milk

Preparation

1 Blend butter and sugar. 2 Stir in vanilla and milk. 3 Beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

About


The perfect icing for Wilson Chocolate Cake.
Variation: Make peanut butter icing by substituting peanut butter for the butter, and increasing the milk to 1/4 to 1/3 cup.
